title: UwU
blurb: Weaponised softness, deployed sincerely on rare occasions and as an act of aggression almost always. Nothing destabilises a Discord call faster than a grown adult pressing this button into thirty seconds of silence — the effect is somewhere between endearing and genuinely threatening, and the ambiguity is exactly the point. The uwu register has been a fixture of internet speech for years, surviving multiple attempts to kill it off. Use it for wholesome moments, for cursed moments, and for the substantial overlap between the two where most of the internet actually lives.
